description: Reverse lookup across engine assets: which scenes/prefabs/Blueprints reference this script, scene, asset path, or handler method? Accepts a workspace-relative path, a res:// or /Game/ path, or a bare method/class/event name (Unreal: called functions via call_function, event handlers via handles_event).

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

name: find_asset_references
title: Find asset references
